verdict.rationale: Kick's docs describe an MCP server that works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP-compatible assistant. Through it, users can look things up, make changes and run reports in natural language, including querying transactions, categorizing, creating rules and executing bookkeeping changes with approval. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the natural-language MCP workflow, and evidence of a native in-product natural-language command interface (natural-language operation depends on external AI clients).
